messages:
eli: hey team, quick permissions / ownership Q. I'm tidying up a few pages for my project and one of the original owners left. Can we transfer page ownership in Notion or do we duplicate and reassign?
harper: welcome eli! Notion doesn't have a single-button "transfer ownership" for pages like a repo. two common patterns: 1) page owner manually changes the owner property on the page (if it's in a DB), or 2) duplicate the page and set the new owner, then update the index to point to the new page.
eli: ok, owner left so I can't ask them. is there an admin flow?
zane: devex/infosec can reassign in some cases. we usually do: devex-bot triggers an Okta/Notion admin action to change the page owner or move the page into a DevEx-managed workspace then we set the Owner field. ping @devex with the page link + reason and we'll handle it.
pat: also if it's a runbook that must stay stable, we prefer to move it under Company Home > DevEx > Runbooks and assign a team owner instead of an individual. that avoids single-person ownership churn.
eli: got it. extra related Q: we hire short-term contractors, what's the recommended way to give them access to templates but not company-wide docs?
harper: invite them as guests on the specific pages they need (Share -> Invite -> email) with "Can view" or "Can comment". don't add them to Redwood - Docs Editors. if they need to create drafts, have them duplicate templates into their personal workspace and then open a PR-like review by adding the draft to the Team page and pinging devex for a review.
eli: ok that sounds safe. is there an approval ticket for guests?
zane: yes, create a support ticket in the HR onboarding form and include the contractor email + pages and duration. For shorter lived access we do manual invites. For long-term contractors we create a temporary Okta guest account that maps to Notion.
eli: any quick checklist I can paste when I request devex to reassign a page?
harper: paste this: 
```
- Page link: <notion link>
- Current owner: (if known)
- New owner: @your-name or team
- Reason: e.g., owner left / role change
- Confidential? yes/no
- Desired retention/location: Company Home > Teams > X or DevEx > Runbooks
```
eli: perfect, thanks. I just posted the page link in the ticket.
devex-bot: devex-bot received request to reassign page ownership for https://notion.fake/redwood/xyz789 and created ticket #DOCS-452
pat: devex can take care of that tomorrow AM. eli — once it's reassigned, please update the Index DB row to point to the new page and add a short note in history so we know it moved.
eli: will do. one tiny follow-up: if I duplicate a template and make edits, any gotchas to avoid so we don't accidentally orphan updates from the canonical template?
zane: don't edit the canonical template. if you need template changes, open a PR in the Templates Feedback thread or file a small change request to devex. if you fork a template, add a comment at top: "Forked from: Template Library (date)" and include rationale. we periodically prune stale forks.
eli: awesome, thanks all for the quick help :wave:
thread_text_summary: New hire asks about transferring Notion page ownership when owner left; devex explains admin reassign flow (ticket to devex-bot), recommending team ownership for runbooks; guidance for contractor guest access (invite vs Okta guest), and checklist for requesting reassignment; devex-bot confirms ticket created.
